name: Vanguard
description: Tank, high durability, holds enemy aggro.

skills.name: Slash
skills.description: A sword slash — basic damage, free.

skills.name: Shield Guard
skills.description: Raises a defensive shield, boosting both defense and self-aggro for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shield Throw
skills.description: Throws the shield at an enemy, dealing ranged damage.

skills.name: Rally
skills.description: Rallies the party, instantly lowering fear and boosting attack for 1 turn for the whole team.

skills.name: Heavy Charge
skills.description: Charges straight into the enemy group, dealing area damage.

skills.name: Sword Judgment
skills.description: A decisive sword strike, heavy damage. Always hits, effectiveness reduced by fear.

name: Mage
description: Ranged magic damage, fragile — fire/lightning/ice element.

skills.name: Bludgeon
skills.description: Strikes with a staff — basic damage, free.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: Summons a ball of fire dealing damage, may cause Burning.

skills.name: Lightning Bolt
skills.description: Fires a bolt of lightning for fast damage, may cause Stunned.

skills.name: Fire Pillar
skills.description: Raises a pillar of fire burning the whole enemy group, high chance to cause Burning.

skills.name: Lightning Storm
skills.description: Calls down a lightning storm on all enemies, may cause Stunned.

skills.name: Ice Age
skills.description: Blankets the whole battlefield in frost, wide-area damage. Always hits, effectiveness reduced by fear.

name: Rogue
description: Single-target burst, highest speed in the party.

skills.name: Stab
skills.description: Stabs with a dagger — basic damage, free.

skills.name: Poison Coat
skills.description: Coats the blade with poison — while active, hits that land also inflict poison.

skills.name: Knife Throw
skills.description: Throws a dagger, dealing ranged damage.

skills.name: Backstab
skills.description: A vicious stab from a blind spot, high damage.

skills.name: Poison Bomb
skills.description: Throws a poison bomb, poisoning every enemy.

skills.name: Flurry Assault
skills.description: Rushes in for 3 consecutive stabs. Always hits, effectiveness reduced by fear.

name: Acolyte
description: Healing + lowers fear for the whole party.

skills.name: Punch
skills.description: A bare-handed punch — basic damage, free.

skills.name: Prayer
skills.description: A calming prayer, lowers fear for 1 ally.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: Restores HP to 1 ally.

skills.name: Purify
skills.description: Target an ally to remove 1 debuff, or target an enemy to deal purging damage.

skills.name: Mass Heal
skills.description: Heals + lowers fear for the whole party.

skills.name: Divine Descent
skills.description: Holy light descends over the whole battlefield: heals + strongly lowers fear for allies, damages enemies. Always hits, effectiveness reduced by fear.

name: Viking
description: Hybrid physical/lightning berserker, high risk/extremely high damage.

skills.name: Axe Slash
skills.description: An axe slash — basic damage, free.

skills.name: Lightning Axe
skills.description: Channels storm energy into the axe, empowering every hit with a lightning splash for a few turns, at the cost of defense and self-aggro.

skills.name: Frenzied Slash
skills.description: A wild physical slash, may cause Bleeding. Hits harder while Storm-Empowered.

skills.name: Throw Axe
skills.description: Throws the axe at an enemy, dealing ranged damage. Hits harder while Storm-Empowered.

skills.name: Spinning Axe
skills.description: Spins the axe through the whole enemy group, may cause Bleeding. Hits harder while Storm-Empowered.

skills.name: Thunder God's Fury
skills.description: Unleashes the storm's full fury on every enemy. Always hits, effectiveness reduced by fear. Hits far harder and consumes Storm-Empowered.

name: Plague Doctor
description: AoE debuffer/support, favors effects over raw damage.

skills.name: Vial Toss
skills.description: Tosses a crude vial — basic damage, free.

skills.name: Fire Vial
skills.description: Throws a vial of alchemical fire, dealing damage and possibly setting the target ablaze.

skills.name: Healing Draught
skills.description: A restorative draught for 1 ally.

skills.name: Blinding Vial
skills.description: A vial of caustic powder, dealing damage and possibly blinding the target — a blinded target's own attacks miss far more often.

skills.name: Spreading Toxic Fog
skills.description: Spreads a toxic fog over the whole enemy group, dealing damage and possibly poisoning/weakening each of them.

skills.name: Total Plague
skills.description: Unleashes the full plague over the battlefield: heals + cures allies, damages and afflicts enemies with poison and fire. Always hits, effectiveness reduced by fear.
